race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 3yo C&G 1st Semi Final Pace
race.comment: ENJOY LIFE (6) has stretched his unbeaten run to eight by overcoming second row draws to win each of his three starts this time in, getting home by close to 4m in last week's heat. Some of his rivals have the advantage of better draws but winning form is impossible to knock. SOHO CHARMER (2) has overcome tough barriers to win his last two outings, working in last week's heat before toughing it out. The better draw sees him as a big danger. MOST EXCITING (1) is consistent and led to win the last time he drew on the pegs so could be hard to catch. CARDIGAN DAN (13) deserves respect after coming from this row to win his heat last week while MAJOR BLITZ (3) draws to be competitive.
